Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class PipelineRunEventEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.PipelineRunEventEntity
@Entity public class PipelineRunEventEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the pipeline_run_events table.

Maps to the immutable PipelineRunEvent domain record. Conversion between entity and domain is performed via the toDomain() instance method and the fromDomain(PipelineRunEvent) static factory method.
